text:
sara: Heads up — saw nondeterministic eval failures on the new quantized checkpoints. Same eval harness, same seed, different outputs ~20% of runs.

sara: Repro steps: run runner with the quantized model, use --seed 42, run 50 trials. About 10 of them diverge. No hardware flakiness in infra metrics.

mike: Do we have logs that print per-worker seed or RNG state?

sara: Minimal log snippet below from a failing run showing worker reuse: 
```
[2026-11-02T14:12:03Z] worker=3 task=eval-qq seed=42 state_hash=0x7f2a
[2026-11-02T14:12:03Z] worker=3 finished task=eval-qq
[2026-11-02T14:12:03Z] worker=3 assigned task=eval-rr seed=42 state_hash=0x7f2a
```
sara: Notice identical state_hash — it looks like the RNG state is not re-seeded between tasks when worker threads are reused.

jia: This smells like RNG being a thread_local static in the C++ sampler. If our seeding code runs once at startup, worker reuse would cause identical streams for later tasks.

lee: Confirmed — the sampler code has `static std::mt19937_64 rng(seed);` in sampler.cpp. That will reinitialize with the same seed only once per process. For per-request determinism we need to call `rng.seed(computed_seed)` at request boundary or use a fresh RNG instance created per task.

mike: Any quick mitigations? CI is flaking on the eval job.

sara: Workaround: run CI jobs with `--worker-pool-size=1` or start runner with `--fresh-worker-per-task` (not ideal perf-wise). Also can patch eval harness to call `sampler.reset_seed(global_seed ^ task_id)` before sampling.

eval-bot: CI failure in job `eval-nightly-quantized` (https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1234) — 4/20 flaky failures today.

mike: I'll open a small patch that moves RNG creation into the request scope and seeds it from `global_seed ^ request_index`. Will add unit to assert different initial states across worker assignments. Taking this one.

jia: When you open the PR please add a test that spawns pooled workers and asserts output equality when we intentionally seed per-request, and inequality when we use the old behavior so we detect regressions.

lee: Also add a comment in the sampler about process-global RNGs being incompatible with pooled worker lifecycles. Saved us a painful debug later.

sara: Thanks — marking as blocker for quantized eval bring-up. Workload owners: @mike to PR, @jia to add tests, I'll update CI job opts to reduce false positives in the meantime. :thumbsup:

mike: PR #2875 opened: `fix(sampler): per-request RNG instantiation to avoid worker reuse contamination` — added unit and integration test, flagged for eng-ml review. :eyes:

sara: Verified on my machine — 200 runs with seed=42 now deterministic. Pushed a small CI config change to rerun flaky evals 2x to reduce noise while patch lands.

lee: Nice diagnosis and fix. Once PR is merged we should sweep other modules that might use thread_local RNGs (tokenizers, rewards sampling) — I can run a grep and list candidates.

sara: Agreed. Good catch everyone.
